harnessArtifacts: No user profile or squire is configured: a user:op sender records replyPathUnavailable: true (message/operator.json) while the UserDelivery double still accepts user: sends; a real home without a squire refuses them with TARGET_UNRESOLVED (TARGET_SQUIRE_UNCONFIGURED before S10).
_adapters is None and no LarkReplyBridgeTransport is built: channel:lark reply bridging is not exercised, and route: sends reach the recording ChatGateway double.

The workflow service (control/workflows-live) runs without the PAC graph authority, PacActorService or RemoteWorkflow, and its cadence runs only at explicit _tick calls; production runs it on its own threads.
The link service thread is suppressed: every link pass is an explicit tick at a recorded point, so link states and inFlight counts are those after the ticks the scenario shows.

agents and workflows (control/agents.json, control/workflows.json) record a daemon with no routine or workflow service: AGENT_DEFAULT_ROUTINE_UNAVAILABLE and WORKFLOW_UNAVAILABLE are degraded-mode values; control/routines.json and control/workflows-live.json record the live services.
Presence is the production _LocalPresence over the registered session routes; there is no remote node, so node-offline and remote presence branches are not recorded.

retention/interaction-after-drop composes the S6 conversation recorder unstarted over an isolated in-process LocalOrgFs (no cell params, so the 7 d code default applies) and drives it and the inbox sweep at explicit steps; production runs both on their own threads and cadence.

Agents are minted in name form (addressing.ID_FORM_MINTING pinned False by the harness): the goldens were recorded before release/v0.5.5.4 made id-form minting the default (UUID addressing, #2546); release's own suites cover the id-form default.
convergence/top-inspect uses a controlled empty process sample for deterministic metrics; the actual host ps and socket are exercised by a separate integration test.

request_methods/pac-gc-preview uses a real PacGc, GraphWorkflowService and AgentRegistry, with the PAC GC test Application and Runtime ports instead of production cell observation composition; production projection revision is covered separately.
